create_safe_apply_chat_template: create a chat template application that resolves and applies a Jinja chat template to a conversation with optional tokenization
build_render_messages: build a renderer that parses chat messages, applies a chat template, and returns a decoded prompt with multimodal data
resolve_chat_template: resolve a chat template string by checking given template, processor template, tokenizer template, and fallbacks in priority order
resolve_chat_template_content_format: resolve the chat template content format by detecting whether the template outputs string or openai format
replace_vision_chunk_video_placeholder: replace video placeholder tokens in a prompt string with runtime video chunk prompts from multimodal data
